Can affect index inclusion, liquidity, and peer perception for tech-focused investors.
Gives traders a date for venue switch and potential index/flow shifts.
Tickers to remain LUMN, CTGG, CTHH
No symbol change reduces operational frictions for holders and brokers.
Regulatory step confirms commitment; reduces risk of reversal.
Signals no direct financial impact; move is positioning/visibility-driven.
